a.lede: The hackers alerted the fashion giant's customers through a push notification that said they had "fully compromised" the company's cloud storage.
a.title: Asos confirms breach of customer data after hackers send rogue app notification

b.title: Asos hit by extortion hack that may have compromised some customer data
